in_marathi.name: Paras
in_marathi.long_meaning: Paras हे एक हिंदू नाव आहे जे भारतीय संस्कृतीत खोल आध्यात्मिक महत्त्व ठेवते। Paras is derived from the Sanskrit word ‘paras’ which means ‘lord’ or ‘master’. It is a name of reverence and respect, often given to a child born into a royal or noble family, or to one who is expected to lead and guide others. In Hindu mythology, Paras is an epithet for several deities including Lord Vishnu and Lord Shiva.
